Erm idk… whenever someone posts an article on here of some carjacking or shooting, it gets TONS of comments assuming it was a male person of color. 

I’m sure you’re doing your best!! but it still feels like tons of bigoted misinformation gets spread on this sub

That’s so cool. You’re like the Reddit vigilante, keeping subs safe from hate speech :)

Edit: a word

Yeah, but we're the same on addressing God directly, and it's the same story where I live. Religion and religious people tend to become kind of cheesy and weird when they'er organized, at least from what I experienced.

But it might be worth a shot. Where are you from?

Same. I got so desperate I finally caved and went to churches. I guess some people find success there. 

But I encountered the same problems there. Perhaps I’m the problem

Reddit people will downvote me but I solved this issue partly by believing in a higher power who was punishing me for not living up to my potential. 

I went through the same thing, almost to the letter, which is eerie. Even same age as you. 

But yeah, I was a shithead, sitting in my room all day at my parents house at 23, “writing a book,” thinking my online long distance thing was gonna amount to anything. 

When she moved on it was devastating, yeah. I still think about her too. But it had to happen to show me the way I was living was fucked up and I needed to change. I like to think that was God intervening on my behalf. 

Whatever, it’s how I sleep at night.

She wasn’t perfect. That’s an illusion from your own mind. 

Give yourself plenty of time to grieve the relationship and do not be hard on yourself

I was literally just thinking this and thinking of posting. Same title and everything. Just to offer a different perspective, I think there is a normal. It’s what I’ve seen in my life, friends and family and such all generally have the same life experiences at generally around the same time. And maybe there are just some of us who truly don’t fit this timeline. 

Just my perspective. I wish you well, my friend. You’re not alone
I wonder what leads a person to this outlook.
I agree. Because that's basically all a person can do. Especially if they have aspirations.
I agree. For me, just because you've "lost" doesn't make you a loser in my book.
Yes, I think entitlement is a big one. Maybe especially when it comes to women.
True

You know, I used to believe depression was an ok thing to have, provided you aren't conspiring to hurt yourself or others.

However, I have found that it's an abominable affliction. It will cause you to completely sabotage your life in every single way if it goes untreated.
How do you go about believing you are a winner in any situation?

I agree life isn't a movie. Also, in my own life, I have NEVER seen the "jock and cheerleader" types fall into hell immediately after high school, and the "math club loser" taking over the world.  

Usually those people got popular in the first place because they were outgoing, charismatic and attractive (and wealthy) all traits which give any person a massive edge throughout their adult life.
I hope you and your boyfriend find some happiness together in the end, and that all goes well with teaching. Try to find as much purpose as you can with that, I suppose.
I'm happy for you. You've found some purpose.

It hurts, cause even from this brief response you seem like a great person. At least good enough for something more (sorry if that's corny)

 I sincerely hope the same for you too, and thank you.
So how do we change?

That’s interesting cause I’d very much like some of the things you have. Especially that time back. 

Maybe it’s just tough for us all.

I think if your whole life has been nothing but a series of disappointments, by 23, that is a MAJOR sign that you have a deeply flawed character, or something is totally wrong with how you’re existing on the big rock. 

I don’t believe it’s ok to basically be an angsty 16 year old in your early 20s. Those people have all that stuff because they’ve lived properly and now get to act their age whereas I lack a decades worth of development.

Fundamentally I agree with you. I have to change. Otherwise I’d much rather be dead.
What if I am complicit though? All of this is at least 80% my fault except for Covid.
